**Finding: deviation (high) — Section 14.2 Deliverable licence.**

Sections 13.1–13.3 already satisfy the preferred position: Affiliates and contractors are named in the Services grant, the paid-up grant in 13.2 is perpetual and irrevocable, 13.3 permits transfer to Affiliates/successors, and revocation is limited to material uncured breach after notice and cure.

The gap is Section 14.2, which gives us only a "revocable, non-transferable licence to use a Deliverable only during the applicable Order Form term" — a walk-away-level grant for work product created and paid for specifically for us, and one that contradicts 13.2 (as 14.3 itself acknowledges for embedded Vendor Technology).

Redline accepted (ok:true): 14.2 now grants Customer and its Affiliates a perpetual, irrevocable, fully paid licence to use, reproduce, modify and create derivative works from each Deliverable, permits contractors acting on our behalf, makes it transferable under Section 13.3, and confirms 13.2–13.3 control any inconsistency. Ownership language left untouched to keep the edit minimal.
